text.en: According to legend, Rome was founded in 753 BC
text.zh-CN: 据传说，罗马建城于公元前753年

claims.excerpt: Founded on the banks of the Tiber river in 753 B.C., according to legend, by Romulus and Remus

text.en: Roman mythology dates the founding of Rome at around 753 BC
text.zh-CN: 罗马神话把建城定在约公元前753年

claims.excerpt: While Roman mythology dates the founding of Rome at around 753 BC

text.en: Rome was founded on the banks of the Tiber
text.zh-CN: 罗马建在台伯河岸边

claims.excerpt: Founded on the banks of the Tiber river in 753 B.C.

text.en: Rome lies along the shores of the Tiber Valley
text.zh-CN: 罗马坐落在台伯河谷沿岸

claims.excerpt: along the shores of the Tiber Valley

text.en: Rome was the centre of the Roman Republic
text.zh-CN: 罗马是罗马共和国的中心

claims.excerpt: Rome was first the centre of the Roman Republic, then of the Roman Empire

text.en: Rome became the capital of the Roman Republic
text.zh-CN: 罗马成为罗马共和国的都城

claims.excerpt: the city successively became the capital of the Roman Kingdom, the Roman Republic and the Roman Empire

text.en: Rome was the centre of the Roman Empire
text.zh-CN: 罗马是罗马帝国的中心

claims.excerpt: Rome was first the centre of the Roman Republic, then of the Roman Empire

text.en: Rome became the capital of the Roman Empire
text.zh-CN: 罗马成为罗马帝国的都城

claims.excerpt: the city successively became the capital of the Roman Kingdom, the Roman Republic and the Roman Empire

text.en: The historic centre of Rome was first inscribed on the World Heritage List in 1980
text.zh-CN: 罗马历史中心于1980年首次列入世界遗产名录

claims.excerpt: first inscribed on the World Heritage List in 1980

text.en: Rome's historic centre is listed by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site
text.zh-CN: 罗马历史中心被联合国教科文组织列为世界遗产

claims.excerpt: Its historic centre is listed by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site.

text.en: The Aurelian Walls were built between AD 271 and 275
text.zh-CN: 奥勒良城墙建于公元271年至275年

claims.excerpt: a gate in the Aurelian Walls, built between AD 271 and AD 275.

text.en: The Servian Wall is the first true wall of Rome
text.zh-CN: 塞尔维乌斯城墙是罗马第一道真正的城墙

claims.excerpt: The Servian Wall takes its name from king Servius Tullius and is the first true wall of Rome.

text.en: In AD 64 the Great Fire of Rome left much of the city destroyed
text.zh-CN: 公元64年，罗马大火烧毁了城市的大片区域

claims.excerpt: In AD 64, during the reign of Nero, the Great Fire of Rome left much of the city destroyed

text.en: Rome was sacked in 410 by the Visigoths
text.zh-CN: 410年，罗马被西哥特人洗劫

claims.excerpt: was sacked in 410 by the Visigoths led by Alaric I

text.en: Rome's population declined to about 100,000 by AD 500
text.zh-CN: 到公元500年，罗马人口降到约10万

claims.excerpt: The population declined to 500,000 by 452 and 100,000 by AD 500

text.en: In 1527 Rome was sacked by the imperial troops of Charles V
text.zh-CN: 1527年，罗马遭查理五世的帝国军队洗劫

claims.excerpt: resulted in the dramatic sack of the city by the unruly Imperial troops of Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor.

text.en: From the 15th century on, the Popes promoted a profound renewal of the city
text.zh-CN: 从15世纪起，历任教皇推动了罗马的全面更新

claims.excerpt: From the 15th century on, the Popes promoted a profound renewal of the city and its image

text.en: In 1871 Rome became the capital of the Kingdom of Italy
text.zh-CN: 1871年，罗马成为意大利王国首都

claims.excerpt: In 1871, Rome became the capital of the Kingdom of Italy

text.en: Roma Capitale has a population of 2.7 million
text.zh-CN: 罗马市人口约270万

claims.excerpt: A special municipality named Roma Capitale with a population of 2.7 million

text.en: Rome's history spans 28 centuries
text.zh-CN: 罗马的历史跨越28个世纪

claims.excerpt: Rome's history spans 28 centuries.

value.text: Rome became the capital of the Christian world in the fourth century

text.zh-CN: 4世纪，罗马成为基督教世界的中心

claims.excerpt: and in the fourth century, became the capital of the Christian world

text.en: In the 8th century Rome became the capital of the Papal States
text.zh-CN: 8世纪，罗马成为教皇国的首都

claims.excerpt: in the 8th century, it became the capital of the Papal States, which lasted until 1870
